rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Having considered the candidacy submitted by the President under Article 103(1)(a), the State Duma resolves, on the results of a secret ballot, to give the President consent to the appointment of Kiriyenko Sergei Vladilenovich as Chairman of the Government, to send the resolution to the President, and that it takes effect on adoption. Signed 'Г.Н.Селезнев', 24 April 1998, N 2421-II ГД.
